department: Department of Civil & Environmental Engineering, FAMU-FSU College of Engineering

deadline.value: Fall Priority Deadline for Assistantship is January 15, 2027 (completed applications submitted by April 1 are still considered for available assistantships); final Fall deadline is May 1, 2027 (Spring: November 1; I-20 deadline May 15).
deadline.quote: Fall | 1 May | Priority Deadline for Assistantship | 15 January | Note: Completed Ph.D. applications submitted by the April 1st deadline will still be considered for available assistantships.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for Civil Engineering; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics, and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: PhD students select a major professor (dissertation supervisor) and supervisory committee by the end of their first semester.
supervisor.quote: The Ph.D. student selects a major professor and a supervisory committee by the end of the first semester. The major professor must agree to serve as the student’s academic advisor and dissertation supervisor

funding.value: FAMU-FSU Engineering PhD programs offer competitive funding packages (RAs, TAs, tuition waivers, health care coverage, and/or stipends), and the CEE handbook notes a limited number of TAs and RAs are available on a competitive basis each semester.
funding.quote: The FAMU-FSU College of Engineering Ph.D. programs offer competitive funding packages for newly admitted students.

also.quote: A limited number of teaching assistantships (TAs) and research assistantships (RAs) are available through the CEE department to qualified M.S. and Ph.D. students on a competitive basis each semester.

entry_route.value: The CEE PhD offers both an MS-PhD track (for applicants holding an M.S. degree) and a BS-PhD track (for well-prepared applicants entering directly with a B.S. degree).
entry_route.quote: The CEE department has two tracks for the PhD program. One track is the MS – PhD track where the applicants already have an MS degree. An alternative is the BS – PhD track where exceptionally-qualified applicants who are well prepared may enter the Ph.D. program with only a BS degree.

fee_waiver.value: Starting Fall 2027, the FAMU-FSU College of Engineering ADRGS office offers a limited number of application fee waivers exclusively for PhD applicants on a first-come, first-served basis (for FAMU applicants, complete the ApplyWeb application up to the Acknowledgement section without paying and submit the waiver request form).
fee_waiver.quote: offering a limited number of application fee waivers for PhD applicants, starting in the Fall 2027 semester. Only PhD applicants are eligible to request an application fee waiver at this time. Application fee waivers will be awarded on a first come, first serve basis.

also.quote: Starting for the Fall 2027 semester PhD applicants can apply for the application fee to be waived.

toefl_min.value: Department admissions pages state a minimum new iBT TOEFL score of 4.0 (550 paper-based); note the central College of Engineering admissions page still lists legacy 80 iBT.

english_waiver.value: India is not on the FAMU-FSU College of Engineering exempt-country list, and departments require English proficiency scores unless the applicant's country's official language is English or they graduated from an accredited U.S. bachelor's or master's program.
english_waiver.quote: The English Language Proficiency requirement can be waived, at the University-level, for applicants who have earned a minimum of a bachelor’s degree or higher in the US or in an English-Speaking Country.

also.quote: For International students, an English Proficiency Score Report is required if: | The applicant’s country’s official language is NOT English or | The applicant did NOT graduate from an accredited US institution with either a bachelor’s or master’s degree.

gre_general.value: Recommended GRE General minimum percentile ranks of 35% verbal and 70% quantitative (148V / 159Q); admission decisions are based on the entire application package, and doctoral applicants may request a GRE waiver.
gre_general.quote: Graduate Record Examination (GRE) recommended minimum percentile ranks of 35% on the verbal reasoning section and 70% on the quantitative section (for tests taken after 2015, the corresponding scaled scores are 148 verbal and 159 quantitative). However, the decision to admit will be based on a prospective student’s entire application package.

notes: Joint FAMU-FSU College of Engineering program; apply through either FAMU or FSU, not both.
